Freelance React, Vue and React Native development

Collaborate directly with a group of engineers who bring thoughtful interfaces, dependable systems and shared product ownership to your project.

Trimugo builds production web and mobile applications in React, Vue and React Native, connected to the APIs and services behind them. Our engineers work together across discovery, architecture, implementation and delivery, keeping decisions clear and progress visible from the initial scope through launch and continued development.

What a freelance engagement covers

Discovery, architecture, implementation and delivery, with connected ownership throughout:

  • React, Vue and TypeScript interfaces — operational portals, internal platforms and dashboards built around a real workflow rather than a template
  • React Native applications, shipped through App Store and Google Play review and maintained afterwards
  • API integration, application state and data flow across web and mobile clients
  • Node.js and PostgreSQL services where the product needs a backend of its own
  • Continued development and maintenance after launch, rather than a repository handover

How a project starts

You have an idea. A product you can describe but cannot build, with no engineering team to hand it to. It is taken from the first conversation to a live release — scope, architecture, build, launch — as a freelance engagement rather than a hire. The first release is built as the first increment of the real system, so it survives if the idea works.

You have a process. Work that already happens every week, held together by email, spreadsheets and people re-typing the same values into three systems. That becomes a connected workflow with state and ownership held by software instead of by a person.

How the work runs

  • Discover. Understand the idea, or the process as it actually runs today — what it has to do, who it is for, and where it stalls.
  • Design. Map the target workflow and define the product, the data model and the architecture.
  • Build. Develop the application, the AI capability and the automation, in reviewable increments.
  • Deploy. Integrate with your existing systems and put it into production.
  • Improve. Maintain, monitor and continue developing the system after launch.

Questions

I have an idea but no technical team. Can you build it?

Yes — that is one of the two ways a project starts here. You describe the product; scope, data model, architecture, build and release are handled as a freelance engagement rather than a hire. The first release is built as the first increment of the real system, so it survives if the idea works.

Who actually does the work?

Trimugo is a group of engineers working together across product design, architecture, development and delivery. Cimala Gowthami is Founder and CEO, and Malisetti Obulamurthy is Founder and CTO. You collaborate directly with the engineers building your product.

Do you work as a freelance developer or on a contract basis?

Both. A freelance engagement takes a defined project from scope to release. A contract engagement supports ongoing development within your team, repositories and release process. In either case, you work directly with the engineers building the product.
